summary_paragraph: A woman with ESRD on hemodialysis via a right tunneled femoral catheter, poorly controlled HIV/AIDS on HAART with opportunistic infection prophylaxis, chronic headaches/post-herpetic neuralgia, atrial fibrillation on long-term warfarin, and recent MRSA bacteremia and C. difficile colitis presented with 2 days of malaise, severe headache with photophobia and neck stiffness, and dyspnea after missing dialysis. Because meningitis was a concern and she declined lumbar puncture, she was initially treated empirically with broad antimicrobials; CT head showed no acute process and serum cryptococcal antigen was negative, and with rapid clinical improvement and no evidence of recurrent bacteremia, symptoms were felt most consistent with chronic headache/neuralgia with possible rebound after narcotic discontinuation and contribution from missed dialysis. Dyspnea resolved after hemodialysis; chest imaging showed no acute cardiopulmonary process. Warfarin was held initially for supratherapeutic INR while LP was considered and restarted at a lower dose (6 mg daily) with outpatient INR follow-up. Oral vancomycin for prior C. difficile was stopped given resolution of diarrhea; valacyclovir was restarted at discharge. Hypercalcemia was managed by holding vitamin D with dialysis, using a low-calcium bath, and continuing cinacalcet, with outpatient monitoring planned; ophthalmology evaluated left blurry vision and diagnosed presbyopia with recommendation for corrective lenses and follow-up. On the day of discharge she had transient chest pressure during dialysis with atrial fibrillation on EKG without RVR or ischemic changes, resolving with return to sinus rhythm; outpatient monitoring was advised if symptoms recur.
problems: Headache and malaise with photophobia/neck stiffness (meningitis considered; LP declined; improved, felt consistent with chronic headaches/post-herpetic neuralgia and missed dialysis)
End stage renal disease on hemodialysis; missed dialysis with dyspnea/orthopnea resolved after HD
HIV/AIDS with intermittent adherence; continued HAART and opportunistic infection prophylaxis; low CD4 during admission
Chronic anticoagulation with warfarin for atrial fibrillation and presumed prior thrombosis; supratherapeutic INR on admission; restarted at lower dose with outpatient INR check
Atrial fibrillation with transient symptoms during dialysis on discharge day; no RVR or ischemic changes
Hypercalcemia in ESRD/secondary hyperparathyroidism context; vitamin D held with dialysis, low-calcium bath, continued cinacalcet; outpatient trending planned
History of Clostridium difficile colitis; oral vancomycin discontinued due to no diarrhea
Herpes zoster history with post-herpetic neuralgia and right eye vision loss; valacyclovir restarted
Blurry vision; ophthalmology evaluation consistent with presbyopia; outpatient follow-up recommended
